question: Which of the following is a summer cropping season in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**zaid.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Zaid crops are grown on irrigated lands that do not have to wait for monsoons, in the short duration between Rabi and Kharif crop season, mainly from April to June, are called Zaid crops in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Zaid crops also known as summer crops, it is mainly known as Cucumber, Watermelon, Bitter gourd.
 
• Zaid crops require warm dry weather as they have a major growth period and longer day length for flowering.
 
• There are three different Crops in India i.e. Rabi, Kharif, and Zaid.
